transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, things just got a little intense recently. 

I was barely settled into my new apartment, and then... I don't know, I just started taking on a lot all at once. I started saying yes to mentoring sessions, and... taking on extra client prototypes for work. I even started redesigning my whole portfolio. It was like I just... had to fix my entire life in one sprint. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
During this intense period, have you needed much less sleep than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess. For a few nights there, I was only sleeping maybe... three or four hours. But I felt fine. I just woke up and figured since I wasn't tired, I should probably just use the extra time to get ahead on things.
During that time, did you feel unusually euphoric or unusually confident?
Um... I don't really know about euphoric. No, I don't think so. I was just... focused, I guess. I didn't really feel any more confident than usual, just... busy.
During that time, did you have much more energy than usual?

I guess so. Um... there were nights where I just couldn't really sit still. I'd end up moving furniture around, or... labeling storage bins. Or just tweaking my design mockups. 

Sometimes I'd just kind of pace through the apartment. It just... stopping felt impossible, I guess.
During that time, were you more irritable than usual?

I... maybe. I mean, earlier this month, I felt really good at first. Almost... electric, I guess. But then... yeah, I suppose I did get annoyed. 

I ended up snapping at a contractor. And my sister. It was just over these tiny delays, but... I don't know, in the moment it just felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting things done. So... yeah, I guess I was a little irritable.
During that period, did your behavior cause serious problems at work, financially, or in your relationships?

Um... I don't know about serious problems. But... I did miss a design review at work. And... I guess I've kind of been avoiding my friends and family lately. 

I just... I feel a little embarrassed, honestly. About how scattered and unreliable I've seemed to people. So I've just been keeping to myself.
Did this unusually energized and irritable period last for at least a week?
I... I'm not really sure. I wasn't exactly keeping track of the days. It just felt like a while.
During that period, did you feel unusually cheerful or high for you?

Um... I think I mentioned this a few minutes ago, but... yeah. At first, earlier this month, I felt really upbeat. Just... electric, I guess. That was before I started snapping at my sister and that contractor over everything. So... yes.
During that intense period, were you unable to do your normal work or daily responsibilities?

Um... I mean, like I said a minute ago... yeah. I couldn't make it to that design review. And I haven't really been doing my usual stuff with friends or family. Just avoiding them, mostly. I've just been too embarrassed about how scattered and unreliable I've been to deal with everything.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Lately, it's just... I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling in my chest. I don't really know why. Even when the apartment is quiet and nothing bad is actually happening, I just... I feel like I could cry over a coffee mug in the sink. It's been going on for at least that long.
Before this recent intense period, have you ever had another similar episode where you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've ever felt quite like that before. Just... recently.
Did this intense period start soon after a specific stressful event?
Um... I don't know. I mean... I guess work is always a little stressful, but... nothing specific really stands out. It just kind of happened.
About how many days in a row did that unusually energized and irritable period last?
Um... I'm not really sure what you mean. Like I just said, I haven't really felt energized like that before. So... I guess I don't have an answer for that. It's just been the heavy feeling.
During that energized period, did you have any experiences like hearing or seeing things other people didn’t, or strongly believing something that others said wasn’t true?
Um... no. I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't... hear things or see things. So, no.
Did that energized period last at least 4 days in a row?
Um... I think I just said, I haven't really felt energized like that. So... I don't know how to answer that. I just haven't.
During that time, did other people notice that you were acting unusually different from your normal self?
Um... no? I mean... like I keep saying, I didn't really have a time like that. So... no. Nobody said anything to me about acting different. I don't really know what else to tell you.
At any point during that intense period, were you hospitalized because of how you were acting or feeling?
No. I haven't ever been in a hospital for... for anything like that. I mean, I didn't have that kind of period to begin with, so... no.
During that recent intense time, did you feel unusually irritable most of the day?

Um... well, earlier this month... I guess I was. I didn't really think of it as an intense time, but... I did feel sort of... electric, maybe. Like, upbeat for a minute, and then... I don't know, I just snapped at a contractor. And my sister. 

It was just over tiny delays, but it felt like they were... I don't know, personally trying to block me or something. So... yeah, I guess I was irritable.
Thinking about that earlier period when you felt electric and were sleeping only three or four hours, did that stretch last for a full week or more?
Um... no, I don't think so. It wasn't a full week. Just... maybe a few days, I guess. I wasn't really keeping track.
Lately, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I don't really do much right now. I used to go hiking at Crowders, or... I don't know, cook something nice. Sometimes I'd sketch out interface ideas just for fun. But lately... I just sort of look at my hiking gear or my tablet and... I don't know. I just don't feel like doing it. There's no pull to it anymore.
